'''''SPF 14897''''' was a [[Mark III bulk transport]] ship that was owned and operated by [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]]. It was under the command of [[Mils Lolinc]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] used the transport as bait in a trap set for the [[Far Orbit]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was supposed to be carrying military-grade control modules to [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], but when the Far Orbit captured her, the hold was full of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Naval Special Forces|SpecNav]] forces.
